description: Generate an AI reply draft for an inbox item by id. Returns suggested reply text and attempts to save it on the item, replacing any earlier AI draft. Spends AI credits. Sends nothing; aidelly_reply_to_inbox_item sends a reply. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_generate_inbox_reply_draft
title: Generate Inbox Reply Draft
